_readme: What counts as a SONG for the Online Library: music with a beat that can become a playable level. 'excludeTags': archive tags/genres/collections that mean 'not music' (whole tag or whole words inside a tag, case-insensitive); such items are skipped without downloading. 'audio': thresholds for the analysis of the first 30 s (the part the level uses). pulseContrast = how clearly the hits repeat at one beat period (0 none .. 1 metronome); measured on real archive audio, spoken word / drones / choral music scored <= 0.11, beat-driven music >= 0.40. Changing 'audio' needs a re-ingest (npm run ingest -- --restart) to re-check indexed songs.
